name: material
label: Material
css: .style-material { background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 64px; box-sizing: border-box; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; } .style-material::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at 120% -20%, var(--slide-primary, #6442D6) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0.08; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; } .style-material > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .style-material .hook { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--text, #111827); margin: 0; max-width: 90%; word-wrap: break-word; } .style-material .text { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--text, #111827); margin: 0; max-width: 85%; word-wrap: break-word; } .style-material .step { position: absolute; top: 64px; right: 64px; font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text, #111827); opacity: 0.06; line-height: 1; margin: 0; } .style-material .brand { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--primary, #6442D6); margin: 0; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; } .slide-code.style-material { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 100%); color: #e0e0e0; } .slide-code.style-material .hook { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--slide-primary, #6442D6); } .slide-code.style-material .text { color: #b0b0b0; font-family: 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 42px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 1px; } .slide-code.style-material .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #6442D6); } .slide-code.style-material .step { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); } .slide-code.style-material::before { background: radial-gradient(circle at 120% -20%, var(--slide-primary, #6442D6) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0.12; } .slide-insight.style-material { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e293b 100%); color: #f1f5f9; } .slide-insight.style-material .hook { color: #ffffff; letter-spacing: -1px; } .slide-insight.style-material .text { color: #cbd5e1; } .slide-insight.style-material .insight-text { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: #f1f5f9; margin: 32px 0; max-width: 90%; letter-spacing: -0.5px; } .slide-insight.style-material .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #6442D6); } .slide-insight.style-material .step { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); } .slide-insight.style-material::before { background: radial-gradient(circle at 120% -20%, var(--slide-primary, #6442D6) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0.15; }
